job.text: _ it! It's so jolly, you know. Besides," he added, "I want you to do something for _me_ now, Mr. Baldhead, so that will turn the tables. A shower is coming up, and it is early yet, so I need not go home for an hour. So, will you not tell us a story? We are very fond of stories,--Bruin and Pigeon Pretty and I." "A story! a story!" cried every one, eagerly. "A story, hey?" said the good hermit, smiling. "With all my heart, dear lad!
